result.problems: (1) FFD d* for log close differs by one grid step between the fit window (0.2) and all IS bars (0.3) on both timeframes; the fit-window value is used so the truncated rebuild reproduces the column exactly, and both are recorded in README/FINDINGS as a caveat. (2) Every model-based column is label-free in-sample for bars inside the fit window (first IS half); the truncation cut (2025-06-30) lies after the fit window, so the causality check covers inference, not the fit's own bars — stated in the README. (3) With h = atr14/close the CUSUM filter fires every few bars (17.8 events/session on 5m): a volatility clock, as Judge 1 predicted; kept exactly as specified. (4) HMM/GMM states separate mainly on bar volatility and the CHoCH-since-BOS count already in the base table; whether they add information is for the importance study. (5) Design choices not fixed by the task and documented: gap-free log return (session's first bar uses open->close) for CUSUM/BOCPD/|ret|; same-session 36-bar windows for the regime vector; rolling-20-tape-bar volume median; GMM full covariance; BOCPD prior mu0=0,kappa0=1,alpha0=1,beta0=1 on fit-standardised series with mass beyond run length 400 folded into the last bin; jump-model lambda grid {1..128} with a BIC-like criterion n p log(SSE/(n p)) + (K p + jumps) log(n p); the ATR-normalised BSADF variant was not built (task fixed BSADF on log close). (6) No OOS label or feature was read; the ledger has 0 rows from this study (its growth during the run came from concurrent studies).
